first-time-talking.npc: Oh, hello there newcomer. I'm Guild Scribe Verity. Do you need me to explain the work we do here?
So it's nice and simple. Just chat to any of the hunters in here to help them out. They're all following reports that I've split up amongst them.
Indeed. There are all sorts of interesting creatures to hunt out there. Sometimes we get reports of a particularly unique example. When that happens, one of the hunters will set out to find it.
If you do decide to take a job from any of the hunters, they'll tell you what type of creature they're looking into. Hunt that creature until you encounter the unique specimen.
Once you've caught it, bring some proof back to the hunter that sent you out in the first place. I'm sure they'll reward you for your time.

first-time-talking.player: I see. Thanks for the information.

steps.npc: I'm the primary record-keeper here. I organise all of our reports and write up anything important to be sent back to the city.

steps.player: Do you go out on any hunts with the others?

steps.npc: I wouldn't know what to do with myself out there, so I like to stay back here with my scrolls.

options.text: How many rumours have I completed?

steps.player: How many rumours have I completed?

steps.npc: Our records suggest you've managed to complete [number of completed rumours] rumours for us!

options.text: I have this spare hunter gear...

steps.player: I have this spare hunter gear, is there anything I can do with it?

steps.npc: Spare, you say? Hmmm.... I'm sure one of the other hunters could benefit from it if you're sure. If you hand it over to me, I can give you some spare supplies in return.

rumour-settings-option.text: If back-to-back rumours are currently on:

steps.npc: Would you like me to filter the rumour information a little more than I am right now?

steps.text: (Repeat rumours will no longer be offered. End of dialogue)

rumour-settings-option.text: If back-to-back rumours are currently off:

steps.npc: Would you like me to filter the rumour information a little less than I am right now?

steps.text: (Repeat rumours will now be offered. End of dialogue)

handing-in-spare-hunter-gear-or-blueprin.prompt: Trade in your [item] for spare supplies?

steps.text: Guild Scribe Verity takes your [item] and hands you a sack of supplies in return.
